column2: 這輛 Thunderbird 的里程表。

column1: Welcome to the Police Quest Driving Interface. We've made navigating Lytton easier than ever before. Here's how:
column2: 歡迎使用《Police Quest》駕駛介面。我們讓在 Lytton 導航變得比以往更簡單，方法如下：

column1: The Lytton City map, shown in the left window, is divided into four quadrants. When you exit the police station, you will be in the lower right-hand quadrant. The map will always display the quadrant you're presently in.
column2: 左側視窗顯示的 Lytton 市地圖分成四個象限。你離開警局時，會位在右下方的象限。地圖會一直顯示你目前所在的象限。

column1: From time to time during the game, the dispatcher will notify you to go to a particular destination. At other times, you'll have to cruise for awhile (that's what traffic patrol is all about) or figure out where you're supposed to go. Using the map enclosed in the game box will help.
column2: 遊戲進行中，調度台會不時通知你前往特定地點。其他時候，你得四處巡邏一陣子（這正是交通巡邏的本質），或自己想辦法弄清楚該往哪裡去。善用遊戲包裝盒裡附的地圖會有幫助。

column1: Your car, by the way, is the flashing rectangle. It shows you where you are at all times. You can also figure out what individual buildings are by clicking your EYE cursor on the streets and buildings depicted on the onscreen map to the left.
column2: 順帶一提，你的車就是那個閃爍的矩形，隨時顯示你目前的位置。你也可以用「眼睛」游標點擊左側畫面地圖上描繪的街道與建築物，來辨認各個建築物是什麼。

column1: The three arrow controls on the bar just above your dashboard are your turn signals. If you click your HAND cursor on the right signal, at the next corner you will automatically turn right at a safe speed. The left signal works the same way. If you wish to go straight, click on the straight arrow.
column2: 儀表板正上方那排的三個箭頭控制鈕就是你的方向燈。如果你用「手」游標點擊右方向燈，車子會在下一個路口自動以安全速度右轉。左方向燈的用法相同。如果想直行，就點擊直行箭頭。

column1: Sometimes you will see a stop sign appear on the middle bar above the dashboard. This stop sign means you MUST come to a stop at the intersection you're currently headed for. To come to a stop, approach the intersection at 15mph or less. Your car will automatically come to a stop. To continue on, click the HAND cursor on a direction and then click the HAND cursor on the gas.
column2: 有時你會看到儀表板正上方的中間位置出現停止標誌。這個停止標誌表示你「必須」在目前正前往的路口停車。要停車，請以時速 15 英里以下接近路口，車子會自動停下來。要繼續前進，先用「手」游標點擊方向，再用「手」游標點擊油門。

column1: The brake and gas pedals are located right next to the turn signals above the dashboard. To increase your speed, click the hand on the gas pedal (the pedal to the right). To decrease your speed, click on the brake. Your maximum speed is 55mph. It's not just a good idea, it's the law.
column2: 煞車和油門踏板就在儀表板上方方向燈的旁邊。要加速，用手點擊油門踏板（右邊那個）。要減速，點擊煞車。你的最高速限是時速 55 英里。這不只是個好主意，更是法律規定。

column1: The siren can be activated anytime you're in the squad car. The switch is located below and to the right of the steering wheel. Click your hand on it to activate the siren. Click on it again to turn the siren off. Only the squad car has a siren!
column2: 只要你在巡邏車裡，隨時都能啟動警笛。開關位在方向盤的右下方。用手點擊它就能啟動警笛，再點一次就會關閉。只有巡邏車才有警笛！

column1: When the siren is on, you can travel at 65mph and pass through any intersection without slowing down including the stop intersections. You MUST also use the siren to chase offenders.
column2: 警笛開啟時，你可以以時速 65 英里行駛，並且不減速通過任何路口，包括該停車的路口。追捕違規者時你「必須」開啟警笛。

column1: When an offender drives past you, turn on your siren to catch them. If you just drive on without a siren, the offender will get away.
column2: 當有違規者從你身旁開過時，打開警笛去追捕他們。如果你沒開警笛就繼續開車，違規者就會逃走。

column1: Highway 41, the Lytton Police Station, the County Jail and the Hotel Delphoria can be entered via a driveway. Just indicate you wish to turn into the drive using the turn signal. Some freeway driveways are exits only, so be careful!
column2: Highway 41、Lytton 警局、郡立監獄和 Delphoria 飯店都可以透過車道進入。只要用方向燈表示你想轉進車道即可。有些高速公路的車道只能出不能進，請小心！

column1: You will not need to utilize the steering wheel, ignition, or radio microphone. As long as the keys to the car are in your inventory, you can drive; as long as you have your radio extender in inventory, you can contact Dispatch when necessary.
column2: 你不需要操作方向盤、點火開關或無線電麥克風。只要車鑰匙在你的物品欄裡，你就能開車；只要無線電延長器在你的物品欄裡，你有需要時就能聯絡調度台。

column1: That concludes your brief tutorial of the Police Quest Driving Interface. If you're unsure as to the purpose of any of the above-dashboard icons, merely click the EYE cursor on the icon for an explanation of its use. We now leave the driving to you.
column2: 以上就是《Police Quest》駕駛介面的簡短教學。如果你不確定儀表板上方任何圖示的用途，只要用「眼睛」游標點擊該圖示，就會看到用途說明。接下來就交給你來開車了。

column2: 這是你的備用子彈，裝在方便使用、而且可能救你一命的快速裝彈器裡。

column1: It's the key to your personal car, a sleek Camaro.
column2: 這是你私家車的鑰匙，一輛時髦的 Camaro。

column2: 這是你的電腦存取卡。

column1: It's the license of Bill Barnum, your DUI suspect.
column2: 這是 Bill Barnum 的駕照，你那位酒駕嫌犯的。

column1: This is your weapon, a wooden gripped .357 magnum.
column2: 這是你的配槍，一把木柄的點357麥格農。

column1: These are your handcuffs. Fortunately, you remembered to remove them from the bedposts before coming to work this morning.
column2: 這是你的手銬。幸好你今天早上出門上班前記得把它們從床柱上拿下來。

column1: This is the Hoffman arrest report. Inside are two licenses, one Hoffman's, the other one belonging Leroy Pierson. He looks remarkably like Hoffman.
column2: 這是 Hoffman 的逮捕報告。裡面有兩張駕照，一張是 Hoffman 的，另一張屬於 Leroy Pierson。他長得跟 Hoffman 出奇地像。

column1: This is the key to one of the best little hotel rooms that can be rented by the hour.
column2: 這是一間可以按小時計費、堪稱一時之選的小旅館房間鑰匙。

column1: What can be said. Anyonme who wears these is going to look like a Miami Vice reject. Oh, that's right. You have to wear them. Sorry.
column2: 能說什麼呢。戴上這個的人看起來會像從《邁阿密風雲》被刷掉的角色。喔對了，你非戴不可。抱歉啦。

column2: 要了解這個視窗裡其他圖示的用途，先點這裡，再點你想了解的圖示上的問號。

column2: 要仔細查看物品欄裡的某樣東西，先點這裡，再點你感興趣的物品。

column2: 點這裡關閉這個視窗，回到遊戲。

column2: 要在遊戲中使用物品欄裡的某樣東西，先點這裡，再點該物品，然後點「確定」。

column1: Ms. Helmut's license has a great photo. Yours sure didn't come out this well. What happened?
column2: Helmut 小姐駕照上的照片拍得真好看。你的照片可沒這麼好看。是發生了什麼事嗎？

column1: Black, sleek, and solid, it's the PR-24 nightstick.
column2: 黑色、造型俐落又堅固，這是 PR-24 警棍。

column1: It's departmental issue pen - always ready for that record ticket-writing day.
column2: 這是局裡發的原子筆——隨時準備好應付開罰單開到手軟的日子。

column1: I bet you never thought you'd be using this stuff. Of course, you probably never thought you'd be using a blow dryer and hair spray to keep that fine 'do in place.
column2: 我敢說你從沒想過自己會用上這種東西。當然啦，你大概也沒想過自己會用吹風機和髮膠來固定那頭好髮型。

column1: It's your patrol unit key.
column2: 這是你巡邏車的鑰匙。

column1: Your radio extender can be one of your best friends.
column2: 你的無線電延長器可能會是你最好的朋友之一。

column1: Your ticket book is full of tickets itching to be written.
column2: 你的罰單本裡塞滿了等著被開出去的罰單。

column1: You don't think handing out a ticket is going to do anything to solve your problems.
column2: 你不覺得開一張罰單能解決什麼問題。

column1: Hmm... Good idea Bond's but do you think this guys really going to drive any safer AFTER you've given him a ticket? What this guy really needs is a night in the can.
column2: 嗯……好主意，Bonds，但你覺得開了罰單之後，這傢伙開車真的會變得比較安全嗎？這傢伙真正需要的是去局子裡蹲一晚。

column1: C'mon Sonny. Fair is fair. She did run that stop sign but don't you think one ticket is enough?
column2: 拜託，Sonny。公平歸公平，她確實闖了那個停止標誌，但你不覺得一張罰單就夠了嗎？

column1: Mustering all your willpower to stare down at your ticket book, you shakely make out a ticket.
column2: 你使出全副意志力盯著罰單本，顫抖著開出一張罰單。

column1: You should follow correct police procedures before issuing a ticket.
column2: 開罰單前，你應該遵循正確的警察程序。

column1: It's a ticket with her name on it. She'll be so grateful to you.
column2: 這是一張寫著她名字的罰單。她一定會對你感激不盡。

column1: That won't be effective now.
column2: 現在這麼做不會有用。

column1: It's your secret transmitter disquised as a fountain pen.
column2: 這是你偽裝成鋼筆的秘密發報器。

column1: It's the key to your unmarked unit.
column2: 這是你無標誌車的鑰匙。

column1: It's your wallet. I'll bet you wish it packed a little more heft.
column2: 這是你的皮夾。我敢說你希望它能再厚一點。

column1: It's an FBI Top Ten Most Wanted Fugitives poster for Jason Taselli. It contains a complete description.
column2: 這是一張 Jason Taselli 的 FBI 十大通緝要犯海報，上面有完整的描述。

column1: any old garbage.
column2: 隨便什麼破爛東西。

column1: It's a warrant to keep that bile heap, Taselli in jail.
column2: 這是一張把那堆人渣 Taselli 關進監獄的拘票。

column1: You can't fly.
column2: 你不會飛。

column1: I'd leave that plant alone if I were you, Bonds. It looks hungry.
column2: Bonds，如果我是你，我會別去碰那株植物。它看起來餓壞了。

column1: The flowers are shy. They don't answer.
column2: 這些花很害羞，不會回應你。

column1: Bert would be very unhappy with you if you picked his flowers.
column2: 要是你摘了 Bert 的花，他一定會很不高興。

column1: The grass is used to being stepped on. It's afraid to answer.
column2: 這片草地已經習慣被踩了。它怕得不敢回答。

column1: You don't need to pick the grass. Leave the poor grass alone.
column2: 你不需要去拔草。別去煩這片可憐的草地。

column1: Hugging trees is nice, isn't it.
column2: 抱抱樹很不錯，對吧。

column1: The pine tree says: "Is it Christmas yet? I'm headin' for Mexico when November hits, man. I'm outta here."
column2: 這棵松樹說：「聖誕節到了沒？十一月一到我就要去墨西哥了，老兄。我要閃人了。」

column1: Hug a tree, not the concrete.
column2: 抱棵樹吧，別抱水泥地。

column1: Why would you play in the street when you could play in the grass?
column2: 明明可以在草地上玩，你幹嘛跑去街上玩？

column1: the dense green bushes could conceal almost anything.
column2: 這片茂密的綠色灌木叢幾乎能藏住任何東西。

column1: You hear rustling in the bushes.
column2: 你聽見灌木叢裡傳來窸窣聲。

column1: You shake the bushes vigorously, scaring the Hell out of a gopher.
column2: 你用力搖晃灌木叢，把一隻地鼠嚇得半死。

column1: Okay, Sonny, we've been given a tip that a drug purchase is going to occur in the park this afternoon. What we need to do is this: You go straight into the park, and position yourself so that you can watch the bench without being observed. I'll go around the side and cover the park's other entrance. Any questions?
column2: 好了，Sonny，我們接到線報，今天下午會有一筆毒品交易在公園裡進行。我們要做的是：你直接進公園，找個能在不被發現的情況下盯著長椅的位置。我會繞到側邊，守住公園的另一個入口。有問題嗎？

column1: No...Geez Laura, I used to play in this park when I was a kid. We used to come here to neck when I was in high school. This is kind of sad.
column2: 沒有……天啊 Laura，我小時候常在這座公園玩。念高中的時候我們還會來這裡親熱。這感覺有點感傷。

column1: It sure as hell is. There are more dealers than ever, and they're meaner and more vicious than ever. Lytton is changing, Sonny. Anyway, let's not waste time. Go on in, I'll see you later.
column2: 可不是嘛。毒販比以前更多，也比以前更兇狠、更惡毒。Lytton 正在變，Sonny。總之，別浪費時間了。你進去吧，待會見。

column1: Bite me. I don't have to say nothin' to you, bitch.
column2: 去死吧。老娘什麼都不用跟你講，賤人。

column1: Kiss my ass.
column2: 親我屁股啦。
